## Problem and evidence

State the specific problem, observation and hypothesis. Link the specification,
journal entry and task. Distinguish historical evidence from this change's runs.

## Resulting behavior

Explain the implemented change, semantic boundaries and any specification or
protocol deviations. Identify new assumptions and unsupported cases.

## Validation and interpretation

Record exact commands, versions, artifacts and outcomes. Include negative
controls, counterexamples or inconclusive results where applicable. Keep finite
tests, bounded checks and proofs under assumptions separate.

## Remaining questions and handoff

State what the evidence does not establish and the next concrete task.
